en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing an elevated view of a European town market square with cobblestone streets and rows of 2–3 story gabled houses and shops. A broad, curving street runs through the foreground with awnings over storefronts. In the background, larger buildings and a hilltop complex are visible. Printed caption text at the top right reads "Nossen i. Sa. — Markt". On one corner building a sign reads "Bäckerei & ...", indicating a bakery.
